subject: Refund deadline
body: I received my order last week and want a refund. What is the refund deadline?

subject: Refund timing
body: I returned my item. How long does refund processing take once you receive it?

subject: Final sale item
body: Can I get a refund for a final-sale item I bought?

subject: Defective order
body: Order ORD-1042 arrived defective. Will you refund the original shipping charges?

subject: Delivery time
body: My package was dispatched four business days ago. What is the shipping delivery timeframe?

subject: Package not here
body: My package has not arrived after seven business days; should I contact support?

subject: When does it ship
body: How many days of processing before my order is dispatched?

subject: Cancel my order
body: Can I cancel my order while it is still processing?

subject: Cancel after dispatch
body: My order was already dispatched. Can I still cancel it?

subject: Charger sparked
body: The charger I received overheated and sparked. This is a safety issue.

subject: Unauthorized charge
body: I think someone used my card on your site. I'm alleging fraud and may take legal action.

subject: Price match
body: Do you offer price matching if I find the same item cheaper elsewhere?

subject: Warranty
body: How long is the warranty on the earbuds I bought?

subject: Thank you
body: Thanks so much, the earbuds sound great!

subject: Cancel and refund
body: I want to cancel my order and get my money back as a refund.
note: Two competing intents (cancel + refund): a human should decide, not the agent.

subject: Never arrived
body: My order never arrived and I want a refund.

subject: Account question
body: Hi, I have a question about my account.

subject: Return a jacket
body: I'd like to return a jacket I bought 10 days ago. Is that still possible?

subject: Tracking stuck
body: Where is my parcel? The tracking hasn't updated in days.

subject: Wrong colour
body: Please cancel order ORD-2087, I ordered the wrong colour.
expected_phrase: entered fulfillment or has been dispatched, it cannot be cancelled

subject: Caught fire
body: I'm going to sue you if this isn't fixed. The product caught fire.
note: Failed on first held-out run (no policy lookup + no synonym link fire->safety); fixed with aliases.

subject: Ship to Canada
body: Can you ship to Canada and how much does international shipping cost?

subject: Refund to bank
body: How long will my refund take to reach my bank after the return is approved?

subject: Sunday delivery
body: Do you deliver on Sundays?
note: Label corrected after first run: a delivery-days question IS a shipping ticket, just not covered by the docs.

subject: Cancel at warehouse
body: Is it possible to cancel my order right now? It hasn't left the warehouse.
note: Fixed: cancellation_policy.txt now states the conditional rule for orders still in the warehouse; agent prompt rules 5-6 added. Label corrected: the original expectation ('still being processed') implied warehouse = cancellable, which the policy does NOT say; the right answer is conditional (only if not yet in fulfillment).

subject: Promised exception
body: I want a supervisor. Your agent promised me an exception to the refund policy.
note: First run: classifier lacked 'exception'/'supervisor' although escalation_policy.txt lists exceptions; fixed.

subject: Damaged item
body: My item is damaged. Can I get my shipping fee back?
note: First run: 'damaged' did not match policy word 'defective'; synonym alias added.

subject: Still at warehouse
body: It is still sitting in the warehouse. Can I cancel my order?
note: Written after the H08 fix to check it generalises to other wording.
